_comments.name: Human-readable name for the monitor.
_comments.schedule.timezone: IANA timezone used to evaluate the cron expression.
_comments.collection: Name or UID of the collection to run. Replace with the Postman cloud UID (format: '<number>-<uuid>') once the collection is synced to Postman Cloud.
_comments.environment: Optional environment UID to use during the monitor run. Set to null if none.
_comments.notifications.onError: Emails notified when the monitor run errors out.
_comments.notifications.onFailure: Emails notified when one or more requests/tests fail.
_comments.distribution: Regions the monitor runs from. Options: 'us-east', 'us-west', 'eu-central', 'ap-south', 'ap-southeast', 'ap-northeast'.
_comments.options.haltOnError: Stop the run on the first error when true.
